$ flow tasks http
http
  Perform an HTTP request and return the response.

  inputs   url*                      string, a URI
                                     Url is where the request goes, written as
                                     an absolute URI.
           method                    string, 3 to 6 characters, matching
                                     ^(?i)(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)$
                                     Method is the HTTP method, and is GET where
                                     a step does not write one.
           headers                   map[string, string], may hold a secret
                                     reference
                                     Request headers, by name.
           body                      string
                                     A raw request body, sent as written.
           bearer                    any, may hold a secret reference
                                     Bearer is the credential for an
                                     Authorization header, and it is the first
                                     task input built to take a secret
                                     reference.
           credential                string, 1 to 128 characters, matching
                                     ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$, names a deployment
                                     credential target
                                     Credential names an outbound federation
                                     target configured by the deployment, such
                                     as "aws-prod" or "partner-api".
           outputs                   map[string, any], evaluated by the task
                                     Outputs selects what the step returns.
           query                     map[string, any]
                                     Query parameters, escaped and appended to
                                     the URL.
           json                      any, may hold a secret reference
                                     A structured request body, serialized as
                                     JSON and sent with `Content-Type:
                                     application/json` unless `headers` sets
                                     one.
           form                      map[string, any], may hold a secret
                                     reference
                                     A form body, url-encoded with a matching
                                     Content-Type.
           expect                    any, must be written as an expression,
                                     evaluated by the task
                                     Which responses count as success, as a CEL
                                     expression over the same `response` root
                                     `outputs` sees.
           parse_json                bool
                                     Parse the response body as JSON into the
                                     `json` output.
           retry_on_unknown_outcome  bool
                                     Retry a non-idempotent request whose
                                     outcome is unknown.
  outputs  status_code               int, 100 to 599
                                     StatusCode is the status the response
                                     carried.
           headers                   map[string, string]
                                     Headers are the response's headers, one
                                     value per name, read as
                                     `${steps.<id>.headers['Content-Type']}`.
           body                      string
                                     Response body, returned by default so a
                                     step can be referenced as
                                     ${steps.<id>.body}.
           json                      any
                                     The response body parsed as JSON, present
                                     when `parse_json` asked for it, so
                                     ${steps.<id>.json.items[0].id} works
                                     without a second step to parse it.

* marks an input the task cannot run without.

Evaluated by the task, not by the engine: expect, outputs
The engine resolves an expression before it schedules the step, which is why an
ordinary input cannot name something that does not exist yet. These the task
evaluates itself, in its own scope, after it has run far enough to have one: it
is how `http`'s `outputs` may name `status_code`.

A step that uses it:
  edition: v2026.4
  name: example
  steps:
    - id: http
      http:
        url: https://example.com/
$
